# Executive performance brief — synthetic example

**Organization:** Northstar Industrial Services (fictional)
**Reporting period:** November 1, 2025 – October 31, 2026
**Generated:** Example layout only; live report values are generated by the API.

## Executive summary

This brief illustrates the report structure. The application calculates the selected-period KPI values from seeded synthetic transactions and does not invent reasons for changes.

## Headline metrics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Recognized revenue | See downloaded period-filtered CSV |
| Operating costs | See downloaded period-filtered CSV |
| Operating profit | Recognized revenue less recorded operating costs |
| Operating margin | Unavailable when revenue is zero or negative |
| Revenue target achievement | Actual revenue relative to prorated monthly department targets |

## Financial performance

Revenue includes recognized transactions and signed customer refunds. Operating costs include recorded expenses only. No company-wide costs are allocated to departments. This is not a full income statement.

## Sales performance

Recognized revenue is shown separately from the synthetic pipeline examples. The MVP does not forecast closed revenue or calculate win rate from a persisted opportunity history.

## Project delivery

Completed projects are considered on time only if they have an actual completion date on or before the planned end date. Incomplete projects are excluded from the on-time denominator.

## Customer insights

The customer view reports historical recognized contribution and last activity date. It does not claim cohort retention, churn, recurring revenue, or lifetime value.

## Risks and recommended actions

The Alerts view lists example rules tied to explicit project-progress and customer-revenue observations. Each suggested action is a review prompt, not a causal explanation.

## Data limitations

This sample report uses synthetic records from the fixed demo snapshot and is not live financial or customer data. The application has authentication and tenant-scoped report routes, but still requires the production hardening listed in the security and limitation guides.
